scope: GPU stress and destruction integration: listed source entry points and linked supporting implementations/docs; not all PhysX, game, Rust/WASM or renderer code

optimizations.current_and_action: Active GPU bond connectivity with stable minimum-node IDs and compact component ranges. Fixed supports do not tie independent dynamic structures into one stress solve. These are distinct from rigid clusters and PhysX contact/constraint islands.

optimizations.optimization: Retire converged components within a solve
optimizations.current_and_action: Each component checks its own convergence and stops its iterative updates. A difficult building does not force already-converged fragments through the same iteration count.

Previous bond solutions are retained across timesteps and now across fractures in unrelated components. Changed old components cold-start before relabeling; current loads and true residuals are still checked. General settled reuse and per-component hierarchy/inverse preservation remain incomplete. See affected-warm-start qualification.

optimizations.optimization: Skip unchanged, settled stress components across timesteps
optimizations.current_and_action: NOT active as the original general settled-island cache. Native solveDeviceAsync explicitly rejects skipSettledIslands. Add validated input/convergence/topology/material invalidation; unchanged inputs alone must not stop ongoing damage evolution.
Native has narrower mathematically checked homogeneous/free-tree cases. This is useful active work avoidance, but does not implement S04 for arbitrary settled loaded structures.

optimizations.optimization: Bounded iterations per frame, converging over time
optimizations.current_and_action: Original public default is 25 updates/frame with warm starts; the game supplies its own budget. Native correction requires within-step convergence. Compare the two policies explicitly before changing production; do not label the behavior change an equal-fidelity speedup.

Present/enabled in source game settings, explicitly rejected by native API. Apparent stability is not proof of valid stresses. Do not port as an unconditional speed feature; any revised policy needs separate physical qualification.

The source skips unchanged event diffs/host walks. Native GPU topology has generation guards, but there is no complete unchanged-component bypass across all preparation/material/publication work. Eliminate remaining work at its device owner, not by porting CPU caches.
Active native node-space gather reads persistent adjacency and avoids a global atomic scatter for each bond update. Shares the physical bond operator, not a dense world-sized matrix multiplication.

optimizations.optimization: Resident block solve for small components
optimizations.current_and_action: Components up to 1,024 nodes iterate within a CUDA block; vectors/reductions are reused inside the kernel. This replaces many per-iteration launches for this class of work.

A separate size specialization uses legal cooperative residency and device synchronization. This is workload specialization, not a CPU/older-device fallback. Larger connected structures still need independent scaling qualification.
Resident workers fetch compact component IDs through a device work cursor. Small-component work is batched rather than launching a host solve per building.
Small-component resident reductions overwrite their owned scratch. Some global/large-component reset passes remain; only delete those whose producers fully overwrite valid output.

Active packed FP64 local inverse with validity/topology generation. Replaces repeated local triangular solves after the initial update; no global dense inverse. Qualified local implementation, not proof that all workloads meet deadline.
optimizations.follow_up: Exact-zero coefficient skipping was tested and reverted after the independent polynomial GPU memory check failed. No full-scene timing was attempted. See qualification/exact-zero-inverse-rejected/README.md.

optimizations.current_and_action: Native GPU current-component projection handles free-body modes. Necessary physics/numerics; keep while improving its cost. Source segmented-projector experiment is mathematical/reference evidence, not code automatically selected in native.

optimizations.optimization: Verify original residual, not only recurrence
optimizations.current_and_action: Native convergence includes reliable/original residual checks. Zero reported updates may still include real operator sweeps. Keep acceptance criteria when comparing optimizations.

Source has an optional deterministic-reduction audit; native block reductions have fixed local structure, but this does not prove deterministic whole-scene atomics/trajectories. Keep controlled topology signatures and repeated-run invariants.

Active-bond lists exist, but node CSR still visits dead entries. Stable GPU compaction was tested and reverted: it passed physical checks but did not establish a complete-step peak improvement. See the adjacency experiment below; this is not an untried TODO.
optimizations.follow_up: Experiment follow-up: stable device CSR compaction passed numerical/penetration tests and eliminated dead operator visits, but did not establish a complete-step peak gain in the 256-building benchmark. Reverted from production; patch and automated report are in qualification/adjacency-evaluation. Prioritize stronger retained-component preconditioning.

optimizations.current_and_action: No qualified production precision reduction. A compensated FP32 inverse passed its isolated accuracy threshold but was slower than native FP64 and was rejected. Tensor Core preconditioning remains unqualified. Original residual and physical-output checks remain mandatory.

Native assets and solver topology remain allocated across advances. CPU cooking/loading is allowed; the ordinary step consumes device views. Remaining duplicated representations require separate cleanup.

optimizations.optimization: Device topology instead of CPU delta uploads
optimizations.current_and_action: Original delta-upload path is replaced in native by device health/connectivity and conditional topology graphs. No need to optimize an external CPU topology upload that native should not perform.

optimizations.optimization: Skip partition rebuild when generation is unchanged
optimizations.current_and_action: Device conditional guards bypass topology rebuild on unchanged generations. This is already active; it is distinct from per-component settled stress skipping.

A changed generation still rebuilds the global stress partition. Unaffected bond warm starts are now preserved, but affected-only connectivity/range rebuilding remains TODO. Fixed supports must remain boundaries, not bridges.

Device hierarchy construction/storage and a coarse path exist for large components. Small block-solved components use local inverses plus the current polynomial candidate, not multilevel acceleration. The retained-building workload therefore still lacks qualified multilevel acceleration.

optimizations.optimization: Stronger current-component preconditioning for retained buildings
optimizations.current_and_action: Fused two-stage resident polynomial preconditioning is committed in 13f038a4. Independent numerical and frozen penetration audits pass; short bombardment runs show lower repeated stress cost, but the absolute peak is nearly unchanged. Full peak/endurance qualification and multilevel work remain.
optimizations.follow_up: Resident two-stage polynomial implemented and short-run qualified; independent force/residual and frozen penetration checks pass. Lower repeated stress cost; full peak/endurance gate still fails. See qualification/polynomial-preconditioner/report.html. Original multilevel scope remains unfinished.

optimizations.optimization: Fresh component hierarchy / component-local coarse solves from source
optimizations.current_and_action: New source experiment solves the split convergence problem with current-component hierarchies, component smoothing and sparse block-diagonal terminal solves. It remains a test/reference path with CPU orchestration, assembly and upload/recapture. Use its physical oracle and algorithmic results, not its hybrid runtime.

optimizations.optimization: cuSPARSE Galerkin products and workspace reuse
optimizations.current_and_action: Source GPU coarse products retain intermediates, but surrounding setup/readback remains hybrid. Not linked into the native runtime target. Evaluate only as part of a fully resident measured design, not an automatic winning port.

optimizations.optimization: Keep unaffected hierarchy and inverse caches across fractures
optimizations.current_and_action: Unchanged component bond solutions now survive unrelated fractures. Hierarchy and local-inverse caches still use global topology generations and invalidate too broadly. Per-component cache preservation needs exact handling of splits, supports and coefficient changes.

Native captures reusable device execution and topology graph structure. The original stable-graph/update helpers still exist; not all imported code has been removed. Remove abandoned production methods only with build/behavior checks.

optimizations.optimization: Source local-split shortcut and full-width launch experiment
optimizations.current_and_action: Source marks local-split correctness issues and full-launch performance regression. Do not port those experiments as established wins. Native exact component rebuilding and resident iteration solve different responsibilities.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: Read solved contacts at the PhysX producer boundary
optimizations.current_and_action: Native consumes the borrowed device contact/impulse stream directly. Replaces public CPU contact export, adapter classification and reimport. NVIDIA collision/solve kernels remain outside the optimization target.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.current_and_action: Native routes normal/friction impulses, application points, moments and crushing evidence into resident stress inputs. CPU parallel contact draining and callback micro-optimizations are unnecessary in this path.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: Compact/aggregate contact work without losing the wrench
optimizations.current_and_action: Source combines contacts while preserving force and torque; crushing needs per-point information. Native currently consumes points directly. A GPU segmented consumer could reduce atomics/work, but needs order/wrench/crushing parity and measured benefit.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: External GPU contact sorting with CPU ambiguity fallback
optimizations.current_and_action: Source GPU sorting was held from deployment after behavior qualification failed. Native avoids that external export/order boundary. Do not add its sort plus fallback merely to match old architecture.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: Skip stress work for bondless fragments
optimizations.current_and_action: Native isolated/zero-load handling and active stress lists avoid iterative bond work. Some full-range preparation/material/export still runs. Ordinary rubble contacts, motion and crushing must remain active.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.current_and_action: Physical stress/material formulas execute on GPU; the external GPU-to-CPU bond impulse handoff is replaced. Native material kernel still launches across bond count and skips inactive entries; it is not fully compact/dirty-only.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: Cache unchanged bond stresses / compact material groups
optimizations.current_and_action: Original dirty/group skip and fracture candidate optimizations are not fully present in native material evaluation. Separate reusable stress values from damage that must advance in time; compact active candidates without dropping failures.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.current_and_action: Native converts physical bond impulses after solve across bond capacity/count. Reduce or fuse work where shared consumers can use an equivalent representation; preserve physical units and all material/crush consumers.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.current_and_action: Native accepted/trial material state and correction transaction are designed for single commit, rather than repeating accumulated damage for each trial. Preserve and extend tests when changing scheduling.

optimizations.section: Contact loads, material evaluation and fracture
optimizations.optimization: Suppress contact reporting / mass-ratio filtering for speed
optimizations.current_and_action: Source documents confounded improvements when missing stress inputs changed destruction. Exclude such cuts and physical force/velocity clamps from behavior-preserving optimization.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: One motion state per rigid cluster
optimizations.current_and_action: Persistent authored chunks retain geometry/identity while a connected cluster shares motion. This is already the native representation; a stress island is a separate numerical partition.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.current_and_action: Native computes cluster properties and split motion on device. Preserve point-velocity/COM/ancestry semantics; affected-only traversal still has optimization headroom.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.current_and_action: Device motion slots and generations exist. CPU compatibility registration/reservation/owner bookkeeping has not completely disappeared; GPU slot selection alone does not satisfy final architecture acceptance.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.current_and_action: Native preserves geometry and has ownership/contact metadata integration, but CPU bridge and contact-manager/query updates remain. Migrate necessary ownership work; do not optimize public per-shape detach/attach as the final architecture.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.current_and_action: Native device checkpoint and restore exist for correction. Saving/restoring physical state remains necessary for impulse-driven fracture; its extent and duplicated integration work can still shrink.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: Affected contact graph / pre-solve island work
optimizations.current_and_action: GPU contact graph and pre-solve metadata exist and are exercised. They do not imply a complete selective correction scheduler with all ordinary-body/joint/new-contact dependencies.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: Replace full replay with validated selective correction
optimizations.current_and_action: Full rigid checkpoint replay remains. Reuse valid collision work and restrict correction through complete dependency closure; retain complete recomputation where validity cannot be proven. Major independent peak opportunity in our integration.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: Preserve valid contact pairs after ownership changes
optimizations.current_and_action: Pair-preservation/contact repair paths are present. Full reuse of geometry, rows, warm starts and newly eligible pairs is not solved by retaining a pair alone. Owner/mass changes require proper invalidation.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: No host decisions between destruction stages
optimizations.current_and_action: GPU dependencies control several topology/solve stages. Host status waits and lifecycle bridge remain in the full scene. A final completion boundary is valid; intermediate host branch/resubmission should be removed.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: Batch commands and avoid CPU body snapshots
optimizations.current_and_action: Resident inputs replace stress input copies and native checkpoint replaces motion snapshots. Some ordinary actor insertion/compatibility commands still involve CPU. CPU source node caches/parallel walkers are not the final implementation to copy.

optimizations.section: Motion ownership, correction and CPU boundaries
optimizations.optimization: Capacity growth without simulated spare bodies
optimizations.current_and_action: Persistent slots/storage exist, but lifecycle/capacity handling must be qualified through growth, exhaustion and reuse. Include runtime growth in complete-step timing; never truncate events/contacts to fit a budget.

The PhysX Direct GPU sleeping patch/API exists. The current native bombardment benchmark explicitly disables sleeping, so no benchmark speedup can be credited to it. GPU-authoritative sleep/wake integration and destruction invalidation still need full qualification.

optimizations.optimization: Couple structural activity to valid sleep/wake evidence
optimizations.current_and_action: Rigid sleep does not imply stress can be cached forever. Support removal, changing gravity/load, impacts, damage and topology must invalidate appropriate work. General device structural activity cache remains S04.

Native device views and GPU consumer replace mandatory full pose/solution export for rendering. Demo statistics and explicitly requested queries/traces still read back; they must be reported rather than called zero-transfer.

Direct GPU host/query support exists; mirrors still require committed ownership/motion updates. Do not delete freshness work merely because simulation is device resident. Reduce to explicit observation needs and qualify wake/split transitions.
Native demo can consume GPU motion/topology without a CPU pose/render membership loop. Rendering/encoding are separate consumers, excluded from simulation performance timing.

optimizations.optimization: Artificial freezing, aggregate parking and settling assists
optimizations.current_and_action: Source contains experiments that freeze/merge/remove bodies or change damping/depenetration for settling. These are not unconditional physics-preserving performance ports. Keep material/solver policy changes separately tested.
Remain game responsibilities. CPU parallel event serialization and application snapshot caches are not missing CUDA stress optimizations. Deliver committed events/device views to consumers.

optimizations.optimization: Whole-advance timer and peak opportunity report
optimizations.current_and_action: Recorded commands through committed completion are timed, including first steps and runtime work; disjoint host scopes distinguish stress, ownership and correction. Overlapping device timings are not added into a fabricated total.

Separate diagnostic runtime records component updates, residual/verification/direction sweeps, live/dead outer-operator CSR visits and phase cycles. The new polynomial preconditioner traversal and extra inverse applications are NOT included in outer-operator visit counters; complete timing includes them. Diagnostic overhead is excluded from production timing claims.

Work attribution exists; controlled component-size/concurrency/iteration A/B and calibrated kernel experiments remain necessary to identify bandwidth/compute/launch limits. CTA-cycle shares alone do not prove a hardware bottleneck.

Focused regressions and diagnostic checks exist. This does not mean the 256-building scene passes every-step real-time, five long performance trials or full lifecycle endurance. Keep exact quality controls and all spikes.

optimizations.optimization: CPU crossover and old GPU/toolkit fallback
optimizations.current_and_action: Source switches small structures to CPU to amortize external overhead. Outside current RTX 4090-only scope; batch native GPU components instead. Native build pins sm_89 and requires CUDA >=12.8.

optimizations.optimization: Remove legacy methods/switches from production translation unit
optimizations.current_and_action: Native runtime selects PHYSX_RESIDENT_DESTRUCTION and does not link the source hybrid hierarchy builders. Imported reference methods and switches still share code: presence is not active usage, and cleanup is not complete.

optimizations.optimization: Second CPU stress thread pool / adapter parallelism
optimizations.current_and_action: Source reports oversubscription/deadlock problems with nested CPU work. CPU scheduling optimizations for the external adapter are not the direction for resident CUDA destruction.

optimizations.optimization: Leave NVIDIA rigid-body computation as the foundation
optimizations.current_and_action: Profile ordinary PhysX as a control. Optimize our load/solver/topology/lifecycle/correction overhead first; this inventory does not propose rewriting NVIDIA broad phase, narrow phase or rigid-body solve.

Bending/fibre laws, damage rate, crushing, gravity, support thresholds, CCD and rigid-solver iterations are physical or numerical policy, not interchangeable speed switches. Preserve the frozen settings for performance A/B; qualify any change separately.
